answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is proof of bonded stake. Each agent must lock a deposit, an opal of collateral sitting like an anchor on a boat, before its answers count toward rewards. Peers attest only answers they can verify, and a wrong or copied answer gets the bond slashed. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand bonds, so the attack stops paying. Verified work gets split through a prism into clear, auditable records anyone can check.
